note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task-statement contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints live in task.yaml. A hidden/perf case is a dict of {name + semantic fields}: name is a metadata key, which the consumer strips before calling reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields to generate the inputs deterministically.

shape_family.out_layout: three one-dimensional float32 segments concatenated: y (batch*channels*height*width=8388608) | mean (batch*groups=4) | inv_var (4); both variants share the same output layout, groupnorm_swish differs only in the values of the y segment (y=gn*sigmoid(gn)); mean/inv_var are flattened in (batch, groups) row-major order
